description: Every source series the model portfolio workflow reads (issue 1398, version one): the regime-adjacent series plus every Base universe asset with a series (universe/base-universe.json). Each id is <provider>:<symbol> (D74). storageKey is the source_value_versions key the series is recorded under: an existing key where another collector already holds that stream, else the id itself. A gap or late inception is served as it is and named in limitation; a proxy is never spliced in by extract.

series.limitation: Yahoo's first ETH-USD observation is 2017-11-09; nothing before it is served.
Gold is the SPDR Gold Shares ETF price, not the spot gold price. NYSE trading days only: no weekend or holiday rows.

series.units: USD, daily index close (price return, no dividends)
series.limitation: NYSE trading days only: no weekend or holiday rows.

series.units: percent per year, supply APY without rewards (DefiLlama apyBase)

proxy.provenance: Aave v3 USDC on Ethereum, the same protocol's predecessor market. The rule is the prototype's (PR 1397, scripts/allocate-data.py): Aave v3 Base from 2024-03-10, Aave v3 Ethereum from 2023-02-06. Extract serves both series as they are; the consumer applies the splice.

series.limitation: Aave v3 USDC on Base. DefiLlama's first observation is 2024-03-10, so nothing before it is served under this id. With the proxy, coverage starts 2023-02-06; there is no lending yield before that.

series.limitation: Aave v3 USDC on Ethereum. DefiLlama's first observation is 2023-02-06; nothing before it is served.

Base universe asset USDC. Yahoo's first USDC-USD observation is 2018-10-08; nothing before it is served. The prototype (PR 1397) treats prints before 2022-01-01 as noise and marks USDC at par before then; extract serves them as published.
